insights.one_liner: StaffingBird is a small Dubai-based tech recruitment agency founded in 2022, with one senior project role listed in Utrecht.

culture.text: A tiny team of about 5 people on LinkedIn, so expect a startup feel where everyone covers several jobs.
Staff studied at places like Utrecht University, HU Utrecht and The Hague University, mostly in law, business administration and international business.
Work centres on HR, sales, operations and business development, placing tech talent in permanent, freelance and flexible roles worldwide.

open.text: Not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors, so it cannot sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa.
Its one open job here, a senior role in Utrecht, does not say Dutch is optional.

growth.text: Founded in 2022 and still in the 2-10 employee range.

worth_knowing.text: Headquarters are in Dubai, not the Netherlands, though several staff studied at Dutch universities.
